title: SAP Monitoring Dashboard
description: Live SAP system monitoring via Prometheus — AL08 sessions, SM12 locks, SM50 work processes, ST06 system performance, ST22 ABAP dumps. Data source: sap-exporter, scraped from S3 every 30s.

list.name: tcode
list.label: SAP T-Code
list.description: Filters the "Active Metrics" tile above to the selected T-Code. All other panels show every T-Code at all times.

panels.title: Active Metrics
panels.description: Number of active metrics for the selected T-Code

panels.title: Total SAP Series
panels.description: Total active SAP metric series across all T-Codes

panels.title: Total Page-In Rate (Pages/hr)
panels.description: Total memory pages paged in per hour across all memory banks

panels.title: Total Page-Out Rate (Pages/hr)
panels.description: Total memory pages paged out per hour across all memory banks

panels.title: Avg CPU User % per Core
panels.description: Average user CPU utilisation across all cores

panels.title: Avg CPU Idle % per Core
panels.description: Average idle CPU percentage across all cores

panels.title: Per-CPU Usage (User %)
panels.description: User CPU % per individual core over time

panels.title: Memory Page-In Rate per Bank
panels.description: Pages paged in per hour, per memory bank

panels.title: Unique Users
panels.description: Distinct SAP user IDs with active sessions

panels.title: Unique Clients
panels.description: Distinct SAP clients (mandants) with active sessions

panels.title: Lock Entries
panels.description: Total lock entries in the system

panels.title: Unique Tables Locked
panels.description: Distinct tables with active lock entries

panels.title: Background WPs
panels.description: Work processes of type BGD (background jobs)

panels.title: Total Work Processes
panels.description: Total work processes across all types
